method: built-in image_gen, one generation per design, transparent background

prompts.A:
Create ONE single full-body game character sprite for English Game. Mature dark low-saturation TRUE PIXEL ART, intended native anatomical height exactly 96 pixels then enlarged nearest-neighbor for presentation, visibly crisp square pixel clusters, restrained detail and dark selective outline, believable adult proportions about 7 heads high, small head, NOT chibi, NOT cute, NOT glossy illustration. 3/4 TOP DOWN RPG camera (see crown of head and tops of shoulders), face and torso oriented southeast / bottom-right, standing still, both boots fully visible. Worn weary pragmatic survivor, understanding is his true power. All objects physically attached or held close. Entire body centered with generous empty margin. GENUINE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no floor, no shadow, no ground projection, no labels, no text, no grid, no detached particles. Muted umber, gray-brown cloth, charcoal, dull olive, desaturated bone and skin. ONLY ONE small Lexicon object contains CYAN / light turquoise pixels, no cyan anywhere else, no halo spill; small precise broken-page and connected-node marks. No large sword, no heroic armor, no medieval warrior pageantry. Prior reference cemetery image supplies pixel cluster style, restrained palette, maturity and camera only, DO NOT copy its swordsman design. Render the visual as a 96px-tall designed sprite at an enlarged integer pixel scale, not high-resolution painterly art.
Direction A, improved worn original survivor. Compact broad-shouldered silhouette with a SHORT ragged gray-brown shoulder mantle ending above waist, hood pushed back around neck, unkempt dark hair exposed, patched practical layered tunic, narrow work trousers, wrapped boots. Short stout utilitarian hand pry-tool held down close to outer right thigh, clearly a short repair tool not a sword. Small conspicuous cyan LEXICON clasp fastens mantle on upper chest. Survivor more than fighter. Coat tails only short asymmetric scraps. Shoulders broad and torso compact.
